placeholders: Four unread territories use the observed per-resident recent-entry average.
Within-state arrivals concentrate in the largest recorded inhabited locality, pending recent-entry counts by town.
Added admissions proposal is an authored one-percent increase over the observed 2023 LPR count, not starting 2026 law.
Resident family and age mix use the existing town household generator until a recent-arrival cohort generator is sourced.
Rent elasticity: Saiz (2007) U.S. metropolitan inflow elasticity, used as a proxy for all localities and 2026; one percent added population raises new and renewed market rents one percent.
